description: Offre de Transport Soléa et Tram-Train en format GTFS is a dataset listed in m2A open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Soléa. Données descriptives de l'offre de transport du réseau de Bus, Tram et Tram-Train sur l'agglomération Mulhousienne Les données sont publiées au format GTFS avec 8 fichiers (agency, calendar, calendardates, routes, stoptimes, stops, transferts et trips). Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Bus, Tram, tramway, Tram-Train, Soléa, TER. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-mulhouse-alsace-fr-portal.
